sources.title: MAS Guidelines on Artificial Intelligence Risk Management (issued 7 Oct 2026, effective 7 Oct 2027)

clauses.reference: Human oversight (paragraph to be confirmed against the final text)
clauses.summary: AI used in material decisions such as credit should have appropriate human oversight, with accountable individuals for the outcome.

clauses.reference: Transparency and explainability (paragraph to be confirmed against the final text)
clauses.summary: Institutions should be able to explain AI-supported decisions to the people affected at a level suited to their materiality.

clauses.reference: Independent validation and inventory (paragraph to be confirmed against the final text)
clauses.summary: Material AI models should be inventoried, versioned and validated before use, with validation records kept.

clauses.reference: Fairness (paragraph to be confirmed against the final text)
clauses.summary: Institutions should assess AI models for unintended bias against groups of customers and keep the results.

rules.title: A named officer signed off the decision
rules.pass_detail: The decision is signed off by a named officer.
rules.fail_detail: No officer is recorded against the decision.

rules.title: Reasons are given for the recommendation and the decision
rules.pass_detail: Model reason codes and the officer's own reason are on file.
rules.fail_detail: The decision lacks the model's reasons or the officer's reason.

rules.title: Model version and validation record attached
rules.pass_detail: The score names its model version, which has a validation record.
rules.fail_detail: The model version or its validation record is missing.

rules.title: Passing bias test on file for the model version
rules.pass_detail: A bias test run on this exact model version passed the four-fifths rule.
rules.fail_detail: No passing bias test is on file for this model version. Run `make eval` and review the result.
